caveats: Only 246 of the 271 DCS text directories appear in the VisualDCS token dump.
A DCS text without a Dharmamitra date is skipped; the row therefore records the earliest DATABLE attestation, which can only push the DCS side later, never earlier.

PD first-citation resolution covers 31,217 of 104,950 unique headwords; the unresolved majority is dominated by post-classical commentaries and the Padmapurāṇa, which the Dharmamitra snapshot does not date.
Both dates are model posterior medians; the lag is an offset between two estimates, not an interval between two historical events.
method: PD first citation: the first known source siglum in the entry body, resolved to a Dharmamitra chronology work (source-date-anchor first, then the DCS crosswalk, then the printed AOB title). DCS earliest: the earliest Dharmamitra-dated DCS text in the VisualDCS token dump that contains the lemma. Both dates are posterior medians from the same Dharmamitra model snapshot, not historical dates.
